Remark
[Optics and stationary phase] ↗ ex:geometric-optics-oscillating-solutions ↗ ex:stationary-phase-wave-equation-continued ↗ thm:characteristic-ode-structure 1. ch4:4.5.3-rem-1\group Asymptotics

The eikonal equations $p_t\pm |Dp|=0$ have characteristics \[ \dot x=\mp p/|p|,\qquad \dot p=0. \] For small time, these straight rays are exactly the stationary sets selected by the phases $\phi _\pm $.
